method: Real-time production input, fixed synthetic noise/pauses

production-new-tuning-noise.measurement: Reference-matched words only; omitted/wrong words counted as errors. Correct spelling uses its last lexical transition, not an earlier wrong spelling. Timings remain estimates from native word ends; no acoustic/paint ground truth.

production-new-tuning-pauses.measurement: Reference-matched words only; omitted/wrong words counted as errors. Correct spelling uses its last lexical transition, not an earlier wrong spelling. Timings remain estimates from native word ends; no acoustic/paint ground truth.
